question.question_text: Select the correct statement regarding frequencies of different object usage in the video

answer_options.text: The mallet was used more frequently than the pick axe during the construction activities by the camera wearer.
Neither the mallet nor the pick axe was used; construction was done using other tools.
Both the hammer and the mallet were used with the same frequency for brickwork during the construction activity.
The pick axe was used more frequently than the mallet during the construction activities by the camera wearer.
The mattock was used more frequently than the combined hoe and fork for leveling the ground.
